2609.24517.title: Not All Task Vectors Need Equal Rank: Energy-Proportional Allocation for Model Merging
2609.24517.paper_summary: Model merging aims to combine multiple fine-tuned models derived from a common pretrained model into a single multi-task model without additional joint training. Recent spectral merging methods improve over simple weight averaging by exploiting low-rank structures of task-specific updates, but they commonly assign the same rank capacity to every task. This uniform allocation ignores that task vectors can have heterogeneous spectral complexity, causing the shared merging space to be used suboptimally. In this paper, we propose Spectral Energy-proportional Rank Allocation (SERA), a simple task-adaptive strategy that allocates ranks according to the singular-value energy structure of each task vector. By assigning richer spectral capacity to complex or isolated tasks and fewer directions to compact tasks, SERA extends SVD-based model merging from uniform-capacity merging to task-dependent capacity allocation. Experiments under standard vision model merging protocols show that SERA improves multi-task merging performance while preserving the same total rank budget as existing spectral merging methods. Further analysis demonstrates that task-level spectral concentration is closely related to the per-task effect of adaptive rank allocation, providing insight into when and why SERA is effective.
2609.24517.paper_summary_zh: 模型合併旨在將多個從共同預訓練模型衍生的微調模型合併為一個單一的多任務模型，而無需額外的聯合訓練。<lb/>最近的光譜合併方法通過利用任務特定更新的低秩結構來改進簡單的權重平均，但它們通常為每個任務分配相同的秩容量。<lb/>這種統一的分配忽略了任務向量可能具有異質的光譜複雜性，導致共享的合併空間未能得到最佳利用。<lb/>在本文中，我們提出了光譜能量比例秩分配（SERA），這是一種簡單的任務自適應策略，根據每個任務向量的奇異值能量結構分配秩。<lb/>通過為複雜或孤立的任務分配更豐富的光譜容量，並為緊湊任務分配較少的方向，SERA將基於SVD的模型合併從統一容量合併擴展到任務依賴的容量分配。<lb/>在標準視覺模型合併協議下的實驗顯示，SERA在保持與現有光譜合併方法相同的總秩預算的同時，提高了多任務合併性能。<lb/>進一步的分析表明，任務級別的光譜集中與自適應秩分配的每任務效果密切相關，提供了有關SERA何時以及為何有效的見解。
2609.24517.author: Hyunjoong Cho et.al.
